changes: Added `/wiki article:<keyword>` (and `m.wiki article <keyword>`) — searches the TheySix wiki and minecraft.wiki in one go. The TheySix wiki article list comes from its sitemap (cached for an hour) and each result shows the real article title and description; minecraft.wiki results come from its search API. TheySix results are listed first, and one wiki being unreachable never blocks the other.

Added `/vd link:<link>` (and `m.vd <link>`) — same as `/dn` but finds the farm by its video link, for when people only have the YouTube URL and can't find the DN. It matches the exact stored link, the YouTube video ID (so `youtu.be` links find farms stored as `watch?v=` and vice versa), or a partial link, and reuses the whole `/dn` delivery: same embed and buttons, same 2-minute cooldown, DMs by default with the `send` option for posting in the channel.
